استؤهلت (form X)
# اُسْتُؤْهِلْتُ (ustuʔhiltu) /us.tuʔ.hil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اُسْتُؤْهِلْتَ (ustuʔhilta) /us.tuʔ.hil.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اُسْتُؤْهِلْتِ (ustuʔhilti) /us.tuʔ.hil.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اُسْتُؤْهِلَتْ (ustuʔhilat) /u
